mostWorthwhile.text: Following the helped B cell into plasma and memory cells was most worthwhile: the branching sequence connected one encounter to both antibody production and a possible later response.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to use the activated helper T cells at the lymph node was frustrating because the result did not explain what was missing. The later compatibility feedback clarified the sequence.

surprise.text: I expected the activated helper T cells to be ready to interact immediately, but the B cell first needed to bind bacterial protein and display a fragment.

arbitrary.text: The need to select the lymph node for the B-cell and helper-cell interaction was not obvious from the attempted pair, although the feedback showed the required location.

continue.text: I would choose to continue for another chapter if it developed the consequences of immune memory or another body-system interaction. The sequence made me curious, though the repeated assembly steps were less engaging than the explanatory results.
